status: Bounded genuine REA investigation completed; no compiler source changes, builds, or timings.

conclusions.finding: File Explorer remains 2.4218 times the matched official executable size. Current color function is 2.7264 times upstream function size, with equivalent source/input manifest.
Current color function size equals previous frozen d4 producer output. Historical reduction from 43,376 to23,044 bytes belongs to earlier changes, not the current selector/getter wave.
Current enum switch cases already use raw icmp identity comparisons. Remaining selector fanout is dominated by arithmetic on num rather than enum cases:31 multiply,15 <=,11 clamp,8 division,8 toInt.

Machine code still has TLS/context acquisition, root-frame work and exception exits. Most of1680 direct BL sites enter small machine-outliner helpers; those sites cannot be equated to semantic calls or allocations.

Separately linked AsciiCodec.encode$c remains392 bytes/98 instructions including TLS acquisition and stack guard. Its SDK body is absent from app program.ll, confirming actual linked SDK boundary differs from a unified test HIR.

next_fix.priority: Build an audited int/double arithmetic specialization across real SDK/program boundaries.
implementation_obligations: Use complete physical receiver CID sets and actual dispatch targets; retain generic wrapper and ABI at unknown/dynamic/FFI boundaries.

Specialize convertFormatValue only for proven primitive numeric callers, or guard primitive CID then preserve generic fallback. Preserve nullable, Mint overflow, integer division/toInt, NaN/infinity, negative zero, and observable operator effects.
Transport source/body-derived proofs through cached SDK summaries and validate them against selected SDK hashes; declaration field metadata alone is not return/value proof.
Maintain all exceptional child paths and stack guard propagation. Do not delete pending checks merely because a function body seems nonthrowing.
acceptance: Actual CLI OFF/ON matched source, frozen producer, tracing/check/shadow flags; differential integer/double/error cases and GC stress.
Count lost selector dispatch and numeric boxing in original and final machine code.
Run quiet repeated color/JSON/HTTP timings separately; final app size includes outlined helpers and all retained graph edges.
File Explorer navigation/close check and complete affected native library gate.
next_fix.benefit: Unmeasured. Function size, callsite counts, and boxed HIR alone do not prove elapsed-time gain.

reference_lessons.lesson: Actual monomorphic-target evidence produces direct-call metadata and separately preserves receiver-null checking.
Unboxing decisions must agree across every member sharing a selector/callsite; nominal num alone is insufficient.
Runtime method metadata may be stripped only after its genuine consumer is absent. Our selector protocol needs our own complete consumer proof.

limitations: Ghidra raw color pseudocode reports bad instruction data/type propagation warnings. Assembly covers every mapped function byte; C pseudocode is illustrative only.
Raw function slices omit external helpers, data and complete callers; mapped direct targets are static link-map evidence only.
No new timing, no whole-program reduction attributed to this work.
Sparse LLVM reference checkout lacks requested implementation paths; no invented local LLVM source attribution.
